priorityList: Interrupt with Quell when the target is casting.
Use Dragonrage as your primary DPS cooldown if the target will live for at least 30 seconds.
Use Potions and Power Infusion while Dragonrage is active.
Use Tip the Scales during Dragonrage, ideally right before casting Eternity Surge.
Cast Fire Breath (Level 1) if the damage-over-time effect is refreshable.
Use On-Use Trinkets during Dragonrage, preferably after gaining 4+ stacks of Rising Fury.
Cast Disintegrate as your main Essence spender; chain your next Disintegrate when only 1 tick remains on the current channel.
Cast Living Flame when Burnout procs.
Cast Living Flame if Leaping Flames or Ancient Flame is active.
Use Verdant Embrace or Emerald Blossom to trigger Ancient Flame and Scarlet Adaptation, provided Dragonrage is not active.
Use Azure Strike as a filler when moving without Hover or if no other priorities are met.
Use Hover to maintain mobility and cast while moving.
